title: Recent Overpayment Balances and the Exit Recovery Share (Network Participation Agreements)
content:
In the exit settlement of a Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement under the **Network Participation Agreements**, a heavy run of recent overpayments lowers the exit recovery share. The exit recovery share is the share of the capitation payments still due that Cascade expects to recover from them.

**Clause.** The exit balance points are set by the agreement's overpayment notices dated fewer than 12 whole months before today, measured against the most recent capitation payment:

- notices totalling at least twice that payment subtract 10 share points;
- notices totalling at least that payment but less than twice it subtract 5 share points;
- smaller totals subtract nothing.

## Terms

- **Notices totalling.** The sum of the amounts on the overpayment notices of the agreement whose notice date is fewer than 12 whole months before today, at their notice amounts.
- **Whole months** are the difference in calendar months from the notice date to today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the notice date's day of the month.
- **Most recent capitation payment.** The amount of the latest capitation remittance on the agreement. Where two share the latest date, the one listed first on the ledger is taken.

## Worked judgements (hypothetical)

| Most recent capitation payment | Notices in the window | Share points subtracted |
|---|---|---|
| 6000.00 USD | 5999.99 USD | Nothing |
| 6000.00 USD | 6000.00 USD | 5 |
| 6000.00 USD | 11999.99 USD | 5 |
| 6000.00 USD | 12000.00 USD | 10 |
